In all 5 rows actually seen the company is the Indian BUYER/consignee, never the shipper. No outbound export record with an Indian port of loading, foreign destination and B/L was found. Source counter: page claims 39 shipments; 5 rows actually rendered, 0 of them exports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; the web_search tool was unavailable for the whole session ('searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>'), so no domestic-supply source could be located. Registered address visible on ImportKey: '5-35/288, PLOT NO.30, MYTHRI NAGAR, KUKATPALLY' (Hyderabad, Telangana) — address only, not supply evidence.
note: Actual shipment fact-check: the only verifiable trade activity is IMPORT-side — Molbright Life Sciences appears as Indian consignee buying research chemicals/solvents from Taiwan, South Korea and Malaysia (B/L 8559988, 7583581, 6282988, 5624688, 3833383). No export shipments and no domestic supply records were found; per Rule 5 this is stated plainly as 'следов поставок не найдено' on both the export and domestic side, not softened to 'условно принят'. Declared HS 293349 (heterocyclic compounds) does not match the observed import lines (29012990, 29039990, 29130090, 38140019) — per Rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual traded codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role reads as trader/distributor of laboratory chemicals rather than manufacturer (Rule 1 — traders are not rejected). Revenue and export volume: null — not public, not invented. No CIN/PAN found; registry sites blocked (403) and search engine down, so legal-entity existence could not be independently confirmed in this session.
